message:
Interesting! There are many fix commits. Let me look at the commit that fixes this specific vulnerability. The issue is OSV-2025-1001 about `_ox_err_set_with_location`. Let me search for commits related to this:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && git log --all --oneline --grep="err_set\|with_location\|location" 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
